responsibility: Provides the base 32-bit Linux rs6000 target configuration. It sets Linux-specific libc feature probing, predefined macros, default CPP/startfile/endfile/library/link specs, assembler endianness and linker emulation defaults, ABI choices such as AIX-style small-struct return compatibility, stack protector offsets, long-double policy, and other Linux runtime hooks used during preprocessing, code generation, and linking.
